contract.unregister_effect: Unregister removes the selected listener from the registry
contract.reregister_behavior: Re-registering a previously removed callback creates a new listener entry
contract.reregister_order: A callback re-registered after removal is appended to the end of the listener order
contract.delivery_order: Emit delivers callbacks according to the current registry order
contract.single_delivery: Each registered callback receives the emitted event exactly once
contract.registry_stability: Unregister followed by re-registration leaves the registry structurally consistent
contract.permission_enforcement: Registration, unregister, and emit continue to require the events permission
